fact_previews: Serendipity is a project that focuses on improving first impressions through conversations.
Members of Serendipity engage in four-minute text-chat conversations.
Participants in Serendipity can be adults of any age from practically everywhere on Earth.
After each conversation, participants rank each other on appearance, individuality, and character.
As participants have more conversations, a clearer profile of how others perceive them emerges.
